announceSlotForm.klienci_zapisani_na_liste_chetnych: Clients on the waitlist get a notification. They respond with “I'll take it” and you choose who gets the slot.
announceSlotForm.klienci_zapisani_na_liste_chetnych_2: Clients on the waitlist will get a notification. For 30 seconds you can still close the announcement without sending it.

sessionActions.zajecia_zostana_rozliczone_zuzyjemy_jedn: The session will be settled: one session is used from the client's package (without a package we'll ask about the charge).
sessionActions.pomylke_mozesz_cofnac_do_konca_dnia: You can undo a mistake until the end of the day.
sessionActions.odwolanie_bez_konsekwencji_dla_pakietu: Cancellation with no effect on the package.
sessionActions.do_zajec_zostalo_mniej_niz: Less than {lateCancelHours} h until the session, so under the policy the package session is forfeited.
sessionActions.nalicz_zajecie_z_pakietu: Use a session from the package
sessionActions.klient_dostanie_powiadomienie_o_odwolani: The client gets the cancellation notification in 30 seconds. If you restore the session in that time, they get none.
sessionActions.termin_zwolni_sie_i_bedziesz_mogl_oglosi: The slot becomes free and you can announce it to clients on the waitlist.
sessionActions.zajecie_wroci_do_pakietu_klienta_a: The session returns to the client's package and the unpaid amount for it is canceled. The session goes back to “Scheduled”.
sessionActions.mozliwe_do_konca_dnia: Possible until the end of the day.
sessionActions.zajecia_wroca_do_kalendarza_zajecie: The session returns to the calendar, the session taken from the package is returned and the open-slot announcement is closed. If the client already got the cancellation notification, they'll be told it was restored.
sessionActions.klient_nie_ma_pakietu_z_wolnymi_zajeciam: The client has no package with sessions left.
sessionActions.zajecia_zostana_rozliczone_jako: The session will be settled as a single session: we'll charge {singlePriceLabel}. You can undo this until the end of the day as long as the client hasn't paid yet.
sessionActions.popros_trenera_o_rozliczenie_bez_pakietu: Ask the trainer to settle without a package.

sessionTypeForm.naliczana_gdy_zajecia_rozliczasz_bez: Charged when you settle a session without a package

slotOfferForms.zajecia_when_zostana_zarezerwowane_dla: The session {when} will be booked for {clientName}, who will get the message “The spot is yours!”.
slotOfferForms.pozostale_osoby_dostana_informacje_ze: Everyone else will be told the slot is taken.
slotOfferForms.ogloszenie_zniknie_a_osoby_ktore_zglosil: The announcement disappears and people who responded with “I'll take it” are told the slot is taken. If you close it within 30 seconds of announcing, nobody gets a notification.
